title: Again on the Cushite and Miriam’s leprosy
english: Again on the Cushite wife and Miriam’s leprosy. Aaron and Miriam, speaking against Moses, are rebuked; Miriam remains leprous a week. The people do not move until Miriam is cleansed. Heretics and slanderers are held leprous in soul [[outside the camp of God’s church >> Bible:Numbers 12:14-15]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).

title: Cloud withdraws; leprosy appears
english: [[The Lord’s anger was kindled; the cloud withdrew from the tent; Miriam was leprous as snow >> Bible:Numbers 12:9-10]]. First the cloud departs, then leprosy — even where the Spirit’s grace is present, detraction drives it away. The former people, blaspheming the true Moses — Christ — lost the cloud; it passed to us on the mountain of transfiguration. Fear lest by evil speech we lose the cloud.

title: Aaron’s plea and the unfinished birth
english: Aaron pleads, [[Do not lay this sin upon us >> Bible:Numbers 12:11-12]]. Miriam is like a miscarriage — formed in the synagogue’s womb, never brought to perfect birth. [[If her father had spit in her face, would she not be ashamed seven days? >> Bible:Numbers 12:14]] Miriam bears a sign of repudiation.

title: Seven days outside and the march resumed
english: In the week Miriam is set apart, the camp does not move. There is no advance until Miriam is cleansed. After her cleansing the people set out from the memorial houses. To whom be glory forever. Amen.
